question: Which public branch/commit is closest to the pipeline that generated the pi0.5 LIBERO numbers in Tables 1 and 4?

candidates.name: miranda-v2 src sweep pipeline (experiments/pi05_libero/src + shared/oracle_gap_table.py)
candidates.commit: 2fdc5ad (2026-04-13, pipeline introduced); 29059a5 (2026-04-15, same pipeline + first public NPZ builder); d5ae9c8 (HEAD, 2026-05-02)
candidates.role_for_table4: likely generator of the Table 4 / Table 15 LIBERO numbers (strong circumstantial + textual evidence); does NOT implement the paper's stated fit/test protocol
evidence_for: [P/R] Paper Table 15 caption is a near-verbatim rendering of the f-string in experiments/shared/oracle_gap_table.py (same wording, same benchmark order GR00T RoboCasa; pi0.5 RoboCasa; pi0.5 LIBERO, 'All benchmarks use beta in {0.1,0.3}')

[P/R] Paper Table 15 'Selected Grid = 18' for pi0.5 LIBERO equals the count oracle_gap_table.py produces from the src condition names at L11, alpha{0.5,1.0}, beta{0.1,0.3}: 4 global + 8 per_step_{0,9} (alpha-replicated) + 4 pos_only + 2 random
[P/R] Paper A.10.2 'up to 152 configurations per task' equals the src sweep: 3 layers x 5 alphas x 3 betas x 3 strategies (135) + 9 random + 8 pos_only = 152
[P/R] Paper Table 4 per-step KS3 'alpha=10' matches src condition naming per_step_{0|9}_L5_a10.0_b0.3, where alpha is a loop label and is NOT used to build or select the per-step conceptor
[P/R] All 10 positive-only cells of Table 4 lie in the src positive-only grid L{5,11} x alpha{0.5,1.0} x beta{0.1,0.3} (the paper's Table 14 grid would allow 60 cells)
[P/R] Table 4 caption 'layer sweep in {5,11}' vs src grids layers [5,11,17] (global/per-step) and [5,11] (positive-only)
[P/M] All 30 per-task Table 4 cells are multiples of 1/15; P(all numerators even | N=30) = 4.0e-9; consistent with the src NUM_EPISODES=15
[P/R] Table 17 (per-task oracle hyperparameters) equals Table 4 Global column, consistent with best-by-prefix from a single summary.json
[R] Author cluster paths (/vast/projects/ungar/stellar/miaom/openpi-new) and B200 SLURM scripts; dates 2026-04-13..05-02, i.e. before May submission
evidence_against_or_gaps: [R] The builder that produced $OPENPI_DATA_HOME/libero_conceptors.npz for the 2026-04-13 sweep is not public; for_subin/build_conceptors.py (2026-04-15) is described as the 'packaged version of the same pipeline' but differs at least in per-step coverage (all 10 steps vs 0 and 9)

[R] Steering checkpoint path is /vast/.../openpi-metaworld/checkpoints/pi05_libero/libero_b200_bs512/2000 (Miranda's own run, train_libero.sh 2026-04-09); fit activations metadata names checkpoints/openpi-libero-2000/. Identity with HF brandonyang/openpi-libero-2000 is plausible (released config documents the same fsdp_devices=4 tweak, same day) but unverified
[R] steering_results/ and steering_results_45ep/ summary.json files, selected_params.json, and oracle_gap_table outputs are gitignored/off-repo; none committed on any branch
[R] No mechanism for held-out LIBERO states: pre-PR#48 client uses initial_states[episode]; driver passes no seed/offset; 15 episodes => states 0-14 = the fit states

components.client_state_semantics: initial_states[episode], episode 0..N-1; env.seed(7); seed does not select state
components.fit_split: authors' fit activations: 15 episodes episode_000..014 (states 0-14 under the pre-#48 client), KS3 8S/7F
components.test_split: none separate; steered eval = 15 episodes on states 0-14 (same states as fit, fresh unseeded policy noise)
components.token_pooling: mean over 10 action tokens (for_subin builder; Apr-13 builder unknown)
components.per_step: strategies per_step_0 / per_step_9 = one fixed conceptor from ds 0 or 9 at alpha 1.0 applied at every step (ConceptorSteeringHook ignores step); alpha in name is a loop label
components.steering_gate: forward hook on gemma_expert layer L output, h' = h @ M.T, M=(1-b)I + bC, all suffix (action) tokens, all 10 denoising steps
components.evaluation_count: 15 per condition, one run, unseeded noise
components.reporting: oracle = max success over conditions in the task's summary.json (same 15 rollouts); summary sorted by SR desc, ties keep insertion order

candidates.confidence_generated_table4: high that Table 4/15 LIBERO numbers come from this pipeline family; medium on exact builder; low on exact checkpoint identity

candidates.name: miranda-v2 45-episode rerun (make_45ep_latex.py / submit_45ep_all.sh)
evidence_for: [R] 'mode: oracle' reruns of per-task selected Global/Per-Step/Pos.-Only configs at 45 episodes 'for statistical significance'; 45 = 15 + 30 under initial_states[episode] semantics would cover states 0-44
evidence_against_or_gaps: [P/M] Table 4 cells are k/15; P(all numerators divisible by 3 | N=45) = 3.9e-14 -> Table 4 values are not 45-episode rates
[R] The generated task_i.sh scripts and all outputs are off-repo; it is unknown whether any paper number derives from this run
[P] Paper Table 1 uses paired t-test + pooled two-proportion z-test; make_45ep_latex.py implements paired t-test + bootstrap CI (no z-test)

candidates.name: miranda-v2 for_subin handoff pipeline
evidence_for: [R] Same author, same NPZ schema, true time-varying per_step (set_denoise_step), mean-pooled + centered builder
evidence_against_or_gaps: [R] per_step condition name has no alpha (per_step_L{l}_b{b}); cannot produce the Table 4 label 'per-step alpha=10'
[R] default betas {0.1,0.3}; Table 4 has beta=0.5 cells (LR5 global and per-step)
[R] dated after the src sweep; described as a handoff bundle for another user

candidates.name: released main / steering-refactor (experiments/libero/*)
evidence_for: [R] Official release; seed-offset held-out mechanism since #48
evidence_against_or_gaps: [R] Steering merged to main 2026-06-01, after submission
[R] per-step alpha fixed at 1.0 and per-step name carries alpha 1.0 only; cannot yield 'alpha=10'
[R] token-flattened, uncentered builder (differs from paper text)

exact_paper_match: none: no public code implements the paper's stated protocol (15 fit -> select -> 30 disjoint test) for pi0.5 LIBERO together with the paper's builder (pooled, centered, pseudoinverse AND, all denoising steps) and a time-varying per-step conceptor at arbitrary alpha

targeted_execution.case: A (qualified) with D elements: KS3 global value approximately reproduced under the candidate's native 15-episode fit-state semantics; not distinguishable from same-state baseline or random control
